ya5.2.2:180.1: Suddhāvāsaṃ uppajjantānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggas. nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha dukkhas. nirujjhittha; aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti ye c' aññe maggan paṭilabhissanti, tesaṃ tattha maggas. ca nirujjhissati, dukkhas. ca nirujjhittha.
ya5.2.2:181.1: Y. y. samudayas. nirujjhittha, t. t. maggas. nirujjhissatīti?
ya5.2.2:182.1: Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti āpāyikānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayas. nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggas. nirujjhissati; aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti ye c' aññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti, tesaṃ tattha samudayas. ca nirujjhittha, maggas. ca nirujjhissati.
ya5.2.2:184.1: Suddhāvāsānaṃ dutiye citte vattamāne tesaṃ tattha maggas. nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha samudayas. nirujjhittha; aggamaggassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā aggamaggaṃ paṭilabhissanti ye c' aññe maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti, tesaṃ tattha maggas. ca nirujjhissati, samudayas. ca nirujjhittha. 12. i.
ya5.2.2:185.1: Yassa dukkhas. na nirujjhittha, tassa samudayas. na nirujjhissatīti? Natthi.
ya5.2.2:187.1: Yassa dukkhas. na nirujjhitthaṃ, tassa maggas. na nirujjhissatīti? Natthi.

ya5.2.2:194.1: Y. y. dukkhas. na nirujjhittha, t. t. maggas. na nirujjhissatīti? Nirujjhissati.

ya5.2.2:196.1: Y. y. samudayas. na nirujjhittha, t. t. maggas. na nirujjhissatīti?
ya5.2.2:197.1: Suddhāvāsānaṃ dutiye citte vattamāne tesaṃ tattha samudayas. na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha maggas. na nirujjhissati; asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha samudayas. ca na nirujjhittha, maggas. ca na nirujjhissati.
ya5.2.2:199.1: Aggamaggassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe arahantānaṃ ye ca puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti, tesaṃ tattha maggas. na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ samudayas. na nirujjhittha; asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha maggas. ca na nirujjhissati, samudayas. ca na nirujjhittha.
